    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    # Each figure is a 3x3 symbol; place symbols left-to-right in color order.
    symbols = []
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
        symbols.append([[color if grid[r][c] == color else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)])
    height = max(map(len, symbols))
    out = [[0] * sum(len(row[0]) for row in symbols) for _ in range(height)]
    x = 0
    for sym in symbols:
        for r in range(len(sym)):
            out[r][x:x + len(sym[r])] = sym[r]
        x += len(sym[0])
    return out
